title.hi: Full term, aur abhi bhi intezaar

body.en: Full term is not a due date. The waiting from here is its own strain, mostly on her. Take the question any news yet off her plate wherever you can.
body.hi: Full term due date nahi hai. Yahan se ka intezaar apne aap mein ek bojh hai, zyadatar us par. Koi khabar wala sawaal jitna ho sake uske hisse se hata dijiye.
